sourceCopy.name: CPM calculator
sourceCopy.title: CPM Calculator Free Unlimited | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Calculate CPM, ad spend or impressions from two values. Free, unlimited and local to your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: CPM means cost per thousand ad impressions. Enter two values to estimate the third; change them to compare simple campaign scenarios.
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Divide the ad spend by the number of impressions, then multiply by 1,000. For example, $10 over 1,000 impressions gives a CPM of $10. The currency is whatever you used for spend.
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: No. The calculation runs in this browser. Your spend, CPM and impression values are not sent to a server.

additionalFaqs.question: Can I calculate spend or impressions instead?
additionalFaqs.answer: Yes. Choose the value to find, then enter the other two. Spend equals impressions divided by 1,000 times CPM. Impressions equal spend divided by CPM times 1,000.

additionalFaqs.question: Does CPM predict clicks or campaign results?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. CPM is cost per thousand ad impressions. It does not tell you clicks, unique people, viewability, conversions or the results an advertising platform will deliver.

fields.mode: What do you want to find?
fields.accuracyNote: Estimate only. CPM does not include platform fees or guarantee delivered impressions.

messages.checkInputs: Check the two values and make sure they are within the supported range.
